name: Your Voice Is Heard
overview:
On the day of Cheng Qing He's wedding, she accidentally regains her hearing, and discovers that her so-called good husband and best friend are just beasts who want her family's property. In order to protect herself, Cheng Qing He has to continue to pretend to be deaf. The cause of her parents' death also gradually comes to light. What will become of Cheng Qing He?

(Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = Google Translate)
